outputs.ratio: Share of pause time in the recording length (%)
outputs.breath_ratio: Share of breath time (label pb) in the recording length (%); NaN when the segmentation does not mark breaths

merge_adjacent.description: Merge adjacent non-speech segments (silence and breath) into one pause; default False = every segment separately as in the legacy module

trim_edges.description: Ignore silence before the first speech and after the last; the recording length used for shares and pauses per minute is shortened accordingly. False = as in the legacy module

min_pause.description: Shortest pause that is counted (s); default 0 = all
